title: Negating inputs in the multilinear extension
statement: Let $P$ be a Boolean predicate on $m$ signs, let $\sigma_i\in\{0,1\}$ specify which inputs to negate, and let $\mu\in\mathbb R^m$. The multilinear extension of the predicate obtained by negating the selected inputs, evaluated at $\mu$, equals the multilinear extension of $P$ evaluated at the vector whose $i$th coordinate is $-\mu_i$ when $\sigma_i=1$ and $\mu_i$ otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean predicate on a finite number $m$ of signs
A choice of whether to negate each input
A real input vector of length $m
